timeline.description: Only brand Shire US is on market with NADAC price $12.85
FDA approves ANDA210046, ANDA212876, ANDA213962. Signal 1 active, but market verification pending.
CMS NADAC posts $0.88/unit pricing for Mylan NDC. Signal 2 verified! 2-Signal detector triggers.

description: Patent litigation prevents commercial market launch. Tentative or litigation-bound approvals with no US commercial market distribution.

timeline.description: FDA signs tentative approval / settlement under patent expiry 2028. No commercial launch allowed.
No generic NDCs commercialized, zero generic NADAC pricing in US market. Detector must report zero false positives.
Amgen Amjevita BLA761024 approved. Signal 1 active.
Years of delay due to patent settlements. Zero commercial distribution in US.
Amjevita launched commercially. Signal 2 verified! Commercial generic/biosimilar launch triggered.

description: Brand-only SGLT2 inhibitor. No commercial generic market entry.

timeline.description: Zydus ANDA214502 tentative approval. Not approved for commercial launch until 2029.
Only Boehringer Ingelheim brand distributed. Must NOT fire false positive.
Teva launches generic emtricitabine/tenofovir commercially. Signal 2 verified!
